name: 5db41abf-wallpaper-networks
description: Задача 5db41abf «Фоновая картинка — на каждую мыслесеть» (0.16.1; требование e6d586d3, операция 31ef478a, сценарий 88a8879d). Стенд: язык сервера ru, две сети (A — пробная сеть стенда, B — из --scenario-seed). Проверено: в сети A картинки нет (фон и сетка); загрузка через IPC me.uploadWallpaper с network_id A; переключение на сеть B даёт сетку и пустые контролы «Оформления» (подпись называет B), сервер для B отвечает «нет картинки»; загрузка для B и возврат в A дают РАЗНЫЕ подложки (сравнение --canvas-wallpaper-image), возврат в B — его картинку; сервер отдаёт картинки с разными network_id; «Убрать картинку» в A возвращает сетку и не трогает картинку B (getWallpaper B = ok); финальный переход в B показывает его картинку с сервера. Офлайн-старт из кэша — отдельный прогон ui-probe.5db41abf-wallpaper-offline.scenario.json при погашенном сервере. Запуск: npm run build && node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.5db41abf-wallpaper-networks.scenario.json --scenario-seed client/scripts/ui-probe.5db41abf-wallpaper-networks-seed.mjs --server-language ru --keep --out .tmp/5db41abf/out

steps.name: open-network-a
steps.probe: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')]; const item = items.find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: canvas-a-empty
steps.probe: (() => { const bg = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.canvas')).backgroundImage; return { attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-canvas-wallpaper'), has_grid: bg.includes('radial-gradient'), has_image: bg.includes('data:image/') }; })()

steps.name: upload-a
steps.probe: (async () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 320; c.height = 180; const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#c02020'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180); const dataUrl = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85); const state = await window.etn.me.uploadWallpaper({ networkId: '{{networkId}}', data_base64: dataUrl.slice(dataUrl.indexOf(',') + 1), mime_type: 'image/jpeg', meta: { width: 320, height: 180, avg_luminance: 0.4 } }); return { status: state.status, network_id: state.network_id, source: state.source }; })()

steps.name: open-network-picker
steps.eval: (() => { const plus = document.querySelector('.tab-plus'); if (plus === null) throw new Error('нет .tab-plus'); plus.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: switch-to-b
steps.probe: (() => { const item = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')].find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 5db41abf wallpaper')); if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: canvas-b-state
steps.probe: (() => { const bg = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.canvas')).backgroundImage; const imageVar = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--canvas-wallpaper-image').trim(); return { attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-canvas-wallpaper'), has_grid: bg.includes('radial-gradient'), has_image: bg.includes('data:image/'), image_var_len: imageVar.length }; })()

steps.name: state-b-none
steps.probe: (async () => { const s = await window.etn.me.getWallpaper('{{networkB}}'); return { status: s.status }; })()

steps.name: open-settings-b
steps.eval: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === 'Настройки'); if (!row) throw new Error('нет пункта «Настройки»'); row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true; })()

steps.name: open-client-section-b
steps.eval: (() => { const nav = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-nav-item')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === 'Клиент'); if (!nav) throw new Error('нет раздела «Клиент»'); nav.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: settings-b-empty
steps.probe: (() => { const section = document.querySelector('.settings-section'); const paragraphs = Array.from(section.querySelectorAll('p.muted')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim()); const block = document.querySelector('.settings-wallpaper'); const [upload, img, remove] = block.children; return { hint_names_b: paragraphs.some((text) => text.includes('Сеть B 5db41abf wallpaper')), preview_hidden: img.hidden === true, remove_disabled: remove.disabled === true, upload_enabled: upload.disabled === false }; })()

steps.name: upload-b
steps.probe: (async () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 320; c.height = 180; const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#2060c0'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180); const dataUrl = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85); const state = await window.etn.me.uploadWallpaper({ networkId: '{{networkB}}', data_base64: dataUrl.slice(dataUrl.indexOf(',') + 1), mime_type: 'image/jpeg', meta: { width: 320, height: 180, avg_luminance: 0.3 } }); return { status: state.status, network_id: state.network_id }; })()

steps.name: back-to-a
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: canvas-a-state
steps.probe: (() => { const imageVar = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--canvas-wallpaper-image').trim(); window.__wpA = imageVar; return { attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-canvas-wallpaper'), image_var_nonempty: imageVar.length > 0, has_grid: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.canvas')).backgroundImage.includes('radial-gradient') }; })()

steps.name: switch-to-b-again
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 5db41abf wallpaper')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: canvas-b-state-2
steps.probe: (() => { const imageVar = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--canvas-wallpaper-image').trim(); window.__wpB = imageVar; return { attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-canvas-wallpaper'), b_differs_from_a: imageVar !== window.__wpA, b_captured: imageVar.length > 0 }; })()

steps.name: back-to-a-2
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: canvas-a-same-image
steps.probe: (() => { const imageVar = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--canvas-wallpaper-image').trim(); return { attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-canvas-wallpaper'), a_same_as_before: imageVar === window.__wpA, a_differs_from_b: imageVar !== window.__wpB }; })()

steps.name: open-settings-a2
steps.eval: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === 'Настройки'); if (!row) throw new Error('нет пункта «Настройки»'); row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true; })()

steps.name: open-client-section-a2
steps.eval: (() => { const nav = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-nav-item')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === 'Клиент'); if (!nav) throw new Error('нет раздела «Клиент»'); nav.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: settings-a-hint
steps.probe: (() => { const section = document.querySelector('.settings-section'); const paragraphs = Array.from(section.querySelectorAll('p.muted')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim()); const block = document.querySelector('.settings-wallpaper'); const [upload, img, remove] = block.children; return { upload_label: (upload.textContent || '').trim(), remove_label: (remove.textContent || '').trim(), hint_names_a: paragraphs.some((text) => text.includes('{{networkName}}')), hint_names_b: paragraphs.some((text) => text.includes('Сеть B 5db41abf wallpaper')), preview_visible: img.hidden === false, remove_enabled: remove.disabled === false, upload_enabled: upload.disabled === false }; })()

steps.name: remove-a
steps.eval: (() => { const block = document.querySelector('.settings-wallpaper'); if (block === null) throw new Error('нет блока картинки'); const remove = block.children[2]; if (remove === undefined) throw new Error('нет кнопки удаления'); remove.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: isolation-after-remove
steps.probe: (async () => { const a = await window.etn.me.getWallpaper('{{networkId}}'); const b = await window.etn.me.getWallpaper('{{networkB}}'); return { a: a.status, b: b.status, b_network: b.status === 'ok' ? b.network_id : null }; })()

steps.name: switch-to-b-final
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 5db41abf wallpaper')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: final-b-state
steps.probe: (async () => { const b = await window.etn.me.getWallpaper('{{networkB}}'); const imageVar = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--canvas-wallpaper-image').trim(); return { status: b.status, source: b.source, image_matches: imageVar.length > 0 && imageVar.includes((b.data_url || '').slice(0, 40)) }; })()
